title: O*NET 45-1011.00 — First-Line Supervisors of Farming, Fishing, and Forestry Workers
publisher: O*NET OnLine / U.S. Department of Labor Employment and Training Administration
notes: National occupational-source baseline for first-line agricultural supervision. Supports broad work activities such as monitoring safety/quality, inspecting crops/equipment, coordinating work, training workers, communicating with managers and solving operational problems. Technician II remains a senior-technician credential, not a supervisor credential.
